scenarios.title: OPS unavailable
scenarios.description: The live OPS adapter exposes a typed unavailable diagnostic, while the hybrid selector may use the declared bounded Platform fallback without claiming a live OPS selection.

scenarios.title: Malformed capability input
scenarios.description: Malformed external capability content is rejected at the live OPS loading boundary and cannot enter registry, selection, planning, or execution.
